text:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the authz outage earlier today. Need owners for remediation items + short timelines. Aim to close high-risk items this sprint.

devon: I can take token validation hardening (missing exp checks + replay guard). Plan: small patch, unit + integ tests, canary. Target: Weds EOD.

nina: I'll investigate audit gaps and retention inconsistencies. Will produce a one-pager with affected services and a sampling script. ETA: Fri.

igor: I'll handle secrets rotation policy and runbook updates; will rotate any keys lacking rotation tags. Expect to finish rotations + docs by Tue PM.

sam: I'll own rollout coordination and the rollback playbook. I'll also create a JIRA template for recurring authz hygiene tasks.

leah: I'll volunteer to add post-deploy verification steps to SRE runbooks (24h metric checks and smoke run).

maya: Good. Two additional requests: 1) add an automated perm-drift alert 2) propose a recurring audit cadence (monthly or biweekly?)

sec-bot: Creating alert ticket for perm-drift heuristic: config-delta OR svc-account-key>45d. Assigned to sec-runbooks.

devon: Notes on token fix: root cause is legacy proxy skipping `exp` check on certain refresh flows. Quick repro locally with test token generator. Test commands:
```
python tools/make_jwt.py --exp -10m --sub test-user > /tmp/bad.jwt
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/bad.jwt)" http://localhost:8080/api/data
pytest tests/auth/test_token_validation.py::test_exp_rejection -q
```
I'll open PR when CI is green and push canary route to `canary/auth-proxy`.

nina: For audit logs, quick grep shows svc-sync rarely emits `audit.write` events compared to svc-core. Example: `rg "audit.write" services/ | sed -n '1,50p'`. I'll attach counts and samples to the page. Also flagging compliance review for any retention change.

igor: Secrets check command I'm using against GCP & Vault:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --project=redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.[] | {name,validBeforeTime,validAfterTime}'
vault list secret/sa-keys | tee /tmp/vault_keys
```
Found 2 service-account keys without rotation-tag. Will rotate and add `rotated_by` metadata.

sam: Rollout plan outline: staggered canary across regions, 10% traffic -> monitor auth-error-rate and audit-write-rate -> 100% if stable for 30m. I'll add watchers and escalation steps.

leah: For verification I'll add a quick Grafana dashboard panel: authz_fail_rate and audit_event_rate per service; will set threshold alert.

maya: Recurring pattern: this is the fourth authz-related remediation we've had in 120 days. Suggest we implement a "hygiene board" with monthly checks: key age, audit coverage, token TTL tests, perm-drift scans. Sam/nina can draft template.

sam: I'll create the hygiene JIRA board + template today, include example from payments-sync.

nina: I'll include reviewer list for retention changes (legal + compliance).

sec-bot: Draft alert rule created: `perm_drift_v1` -> will post playbook snippet here once approved.

devon: Canary discovered a race when cache eviction happens concurrently with validation; I'm adding a short mutex and 50ms jitter to reduce window.

igor: After rotation I'll run a smoke that hits audit endpoints to ensure writes still flow and keys are valid.

maya: Action summary (short):
- devon: token validation patch + tests + canary — Weds EOD
- nina: audit coverage doc + sampling — Fri
- igor: secrets rotation + runbook updates — Tue PM
- sam: rollout schedule + hygiene JIRA board — Tue/Wed
- leah: post-deploy verification + dashboard panels — Wed
- sec-bot/sec-runbooks: perm-drift alert + playbook — 48h

maya: Please tag your JIRA subtasks with `postmortem:authz-2026` and add reviewers. We'll reconvene Wed 10:30 for a 30-min handoff and status check. Drop quick updates here if you find other affected services. :white_check_mark:
